Talk to your robot while it works 🗣️🤖

New in LeRobot 0.7: interactive rollouts. Start a policy, then steer it mid-run, without a reset:

- /subtask: switch what it's doing
- /vqa: ask what it sees
- /autosteer: give it a goal and let a planner pick the steps
- record episodes while you steer

lerobot-rollout --interactive=true

No text-generating policy? Bring any VLM as the planner: transformers serve, vLLM or Inference Providers.

And FineART-VLA, trained on FineART from @scale_AI and Hugging Face (1,718 h, 533,913 subtask labels), says its next subtask out loud, then does it.
